content.title: X (Twitter) was down - Live updates as thousands report outages
content.text: Elon Musk's X appeared suffer an outage with the desktop version suffering the most. 60% of the reports were related to the browser version of X, with the rest around logging in and the mobile app.A sudden influx of reports appeared on the outage tracking site Down Detector starting around 1:45 p.m. Pacific, spiking around 4,000 reports in the first 20 minutes. Refresh March 23, 2026 at 9:10 PM Sudden spike (Image credit: Down Detector)On Down Detector, X saw a sudden spike in reports around 1:40 p.m. Pacific quickly surpassing 4,000 reports. March 23, 2026 at 9:13 PM No changes at X API status page (Image credit: X) The official developer API page is not reflecting an outage.Currently, it shows green across the board. An incident would change the system to yellow, usually with a description. March 23, 2026 at 9:15 PM Ice cream error (Image credit: X.com) I've been able to navigate X on my phone but this is what I'm seeing when I try to use the browser version.What are you seeing? March 23, 2026 at 9:23 PM Intermittent access March 23, 2026 at 9:36 PM Third outage in as many months (Image credit: Shutterstock) X has seemingly had at least one outage every month in 2026 including a blip just five days ago.You can find any number of threads on Reddit and other places discussing an increasing number of bugs and issues with the app.The service appears to work most of the time. Though it is infested with bots and a certain bias, so maybe its not working as intended. March 23, 2026 at 9:47 PM Reports declining (Image credit: Down Detector) On Down Detector hit a high of nearly 4,300 reports, but has been in a slow decline since 2 p.m. Pacific.As of this posting, its sitting at 3,200 reports.I've been able to access X regularly and the dev status page has never updated to reflect.Comments around the outage are hard to find. Down Detector can devolve into weird trolling in its comment section and X is especially bad for unhelpful commentors. March 23, 2026 at 10:00 PM Where are the problems? March 23, 2026 at 10:09 PM Reports halved March 23, 2026 at 10:16 PM Outage is over (Image credit: Down Detector) Reports have finally dipped under 500 on Down Detector, which usually means the outage is over.The memes in the comment section have started to disappear as well, meaning their object of distraction is no longer needed.
